subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should this PR's nested mainRestartRecovery fuse/tombstone model be accepted as the canonical implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750 instead of the other open candidate PR?
rationale: The patch changes persisted session recovery state and intentionally changes availability behavior, while another open PR targets the same incident; automation should not choose the shipped contract by itself.

options.title: Accept This Fuse Contract
options.body: Treat this head as the canonical fix once exact-head checks are clean, then redirect the overlapping candidate after merge.

options.title: Require One More Restart Proof
options.body: Ask for supervised gateway-restart proof if the file-backed runtime output and Mantis Telegram proof are not enough for the availability tradeoff.

options.title: Prefer The Other Candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if maintainers select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 as the viable canonical landing path.

recommendation.title: Accept This Fuse Contract
recommendation.body: Treat this head as the canonical fix once exact-head checks are clean, then redirect the overlapping candidate after merge.
